summary: First end-to-end test of FieldCRM SaaS MVP. Backend: 23/24 pytest cases pass (95.8%). Frontend: landing, tenant admin login, dashboard, branding, products, employee PWA, customer PWA + full order flow all working. Multi-tenant auth (super_admin/tenant_admin/manager/employee/customer) with mock OTP, JWT, tenant isolation, role isolation, analytics, CSV export, notifications all functional.

minor.issue: Filter uses assigned_employee_id==user.sub. When an employee creates an enquiry without explicitly setting assigned_employee_id, they cannot see it back in their list. Consider including created_by==user.sub in the OR clause for employees so a self-created enquiry is visible to its creator.

design_issues.screen: Customer Catalogue & Tenant Admin Products grid
issues: Product cards show placeholder letter avatars (B, C, G, P, S) instead of actual product images. Seed data has no image_path. Consider seeding real product images or generated thumbnails for a more polished demo.

action_items: [MINOR] Enquiry visibility for employee creators — extend GET /api/enquiries filter to include {created_by: user.sub} OR {assigned_employee_id: user.sub} for employees so an enquiry they raised themselves shows up.
[DESIGN] Add product image seeds in /app/backend/seed.py (or generate placeholders server-side) so product cards show images instead of letter avatars.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1236 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, super, tenant, employee, customer, files, analytics) for maintainability.
list_orders for employees filters by assigned_employee_id only — orders created by customers who have no assigned_employee_id will be invisible to all employees. Acceptable for MVP but document.
expected_otp returns the same DEMO_OTP for every non-super-admin phone — fine for MVP (mocked) but explicitly documented in code as MVP-only.
/api/files/view accepts token via ?auth= query param — acceptable for img tag usage but consider short-lived signed URLs in production.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/request-otp or /api/auth/verify-otp — production hardening required.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_fieldcrm.py covers health, public endpoints, OTP auth, super admin (tenants/plans/analytics/create), tenant admin (profile/labels/users/products CRUD), employee flows (checkin/visits/sales/collections/dcr/enquiries), customer order flow + status guard, analytics, CSV export, notifications. Single known failing case is test_employee_visits_sales_collections_dcr_enquiries due to enquiry filter quirk noted above — adjust either the API or the test (assigned_employee_id field on POST) after fix.
rca of the issue: Enquiry visibility for employee: in server.py list_enquiries, when user.role==employee, query is q['assigned_employee_id']=user.sub. POST /api/enquiries with no assigned_employee_id stores assigned_employee_id=null, so the creating employee's subsequent GET /enquiries returns []. Fix: change employee branch to q['$or']=[{assigned_employee_id:user.sub},{created_by:user.sub}].
